ValidationRule.description: Shipments for projects with risk above 7 (VLOOKUP by project Name) need Signature Required, and high-risk international shipments cannot go Ground or be declared above 5000.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Project_Name_Ref__c)), NULLVALUE(VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Risk_Score__c, $ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Name, Project_Name_Ref__c), 0) > 7, OR( NOT(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Signature Required')), AND(Is_International__c, OR(ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Ground'), NULLVALUE(Declared_Value__c, 0) > 5000)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: High-risk project shipments need Signature Required handling and cannot be declared that high.
